highlights: Document this query: open the query in Diagramforce, my free diagramming app, as a data model of its tables and joins, or as lineage from the source fields through the query to its target Data Extension. Only names and expressions leave SQL Studio, never rows.

Lint tested on Marketing Cloud Engagement itself: over 100 tests on a real account shaped 24 new rules and fixed dozens more. Lint catches what MCE refuses or breaks before you click Run, even a -- comment that hides the rest of the query from MCE's save, and valid SQL no longer gets false errors.
Safer saves: Save, Save As and Save to DE stop on lint errors, with Save anyway, so a Query Activity that would fail when its automation runs is caught before it is stored.

Format follows my extended style guide: the guide now covers blank lines around UNION, aligned end-of-line comments, table aliases on the tab stop, line comments and more, and Format lays out SQL as my articles do.

Claude skill, updated: SF MCE SQL gives Claude every new rule and fix, the facts from those tests and the extended style guide, so it writes, checks and fixes SQL the way MCE actually runs it. Get it from Help > Write SQL with Claude.
